title: Senator John Heinz Professor of Management Practice in Environmental Management, Retired
bio: New nuclear power must pass the ‘Chindia test’ — this energy source should be built like modern aviation or shipping Synopsis "We should try to change radiophobia now — if we build new nuclear power plants at the scale required to fulfill global energy needs, there will be occasional failures, just as there are in aviation or construction. However, these need not become massive disasters. Radiation was not a disaster in Fukushima per se — obsolete policies and human reactions brought on much of the difficulties," Lassiter said.
